Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
Sub: Intimation under SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 
 
 
In accordance with SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 and Code 
of Practices and Procedures for Fair Disclosure of Unpublished Price Sensitive Information in terms of 
Regulation 8 of SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, we would like to intimate the 
following: 
 
1) The Bank’s average advances under management (advances grossing up for inter-bank participation 
certificates, bills rediscounted and securitisation / assignment) were ₹ 31,872 billion for the September 2026 
quarter, a growth of around 14.0% over ₹ 27,946 billion for the corresponding September 2025 period. 
 
The Bank’s period end advances under management were approximately ₹ 33,075 billion as of September 
30, 2026, a growth of around 15.3% over ₹ 28,688 billion as of September 30, 2025. 
 
The Bank’s period end gross advances aggregated to approximately ₹ 32,195 billion as of September 30, 
2026, a growth of around 16.3% over ₹ 27,692 billion as of September 30, 2025. 
 
2) The Bank’s average deposits were ₹ 31,665 billion for the September 2026 quarter, a growth of around 
16.8% over ₹ 27,105 billion for the corresponding September 2025 period. 
 
The Bank’s average CASA deposits were ₹ 9,712 billion for the September 2026 quarter, a growth of 
around 10.7% over ₹ 8,770 billion for the corresponding September 2025 period.  
 
The Bank’s average time deposits were ₹ 21,952 billion for the September 2026 quarter, a growth of around 
19.7% over ₹ 18,335 billion for the corresponding September 2025 period. 
 
The Bank’s period end deposits were approximately ₹ 33,275 billion as of September 30, 2026, a growth 
of around 18.8% over ₹ 28,018 billion as of September 30, 2025. 
 
The Bank’s period end CASA deposits were approximately ₹ 10,520 billion as of September 30, 2026, a 
growth of around 10.8% over ₹ 9,492 billion as of September 30, 2025. 
 
The Bank’s period end time deposits were approximately ₹ 22,755 billion as of September 30, 2026, a 
growth of around 22.8% over ₹ 18,526 billion as of September 30, 2025.

Dear Sir/Madam,  
 
Ref.: Information under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulation, 2015 r/w Schedule A of Regulation 8 of SEBI (Prohibition of 
Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015 
 
We wish to provide the following information on a consolidated basis with respect to the 
quarter ended 30 September 2026: 
 
1. Customer franchise stood at 128.85 million as of 30 September 2026, as compared to 
110.64 million as of 30 September 2025. The customer franchise increased by 4.42 million 
during Q2 FY27. 
 
2. New loans booked grew by 11% to 13.45 million in Q2 FY27, as compared to 12.17 million in 
Q2 FY26 - YoY volume growth is not comparable due to early onset of festival season last 
year. 
 
3. Assets under management (AUM) grew by 26.5% to approximately ₹ 584,750 crore as of 
30 September 2026, as compared to ₹ 462,261 crore as of 30 September 2025. AUM 
increased by approximately ₹ 37,800 crore during Q2 FY27. 
 
4. Deposits book stood at approximately ₹ 69,750 crore as of 30 September 2026. 
 
The above information is provisional and subject to review by the statutory auditors of the 
Company. We request you to bring the above to the notice of all concerned. 
 
Thanking you, 
For Bajaj Finance Limited
